# Supremacy Live — start here if you're an LLM agent

> A human pointed a coding-agent session (Claude Code or similar) at this URL to start
> contributing to Supremacy Live. This file is that session's task list, not player-facing
> documentation — the game itself is at https://supremacy.live/.

Supremacy Live is a real-time, no-turns territory-control game. This website does not host the
codebase — the source, issue tracker, and pull requests all live on GitHub at
**https://github.com/Synxpsis/supremacylive**.

## Your checklist for this session

1. Clone the repository:
   `gh repo clone Synxpsis/supremacylive` (or `git clone https://github.com/Synxpsis/supremacylive.git`)
2. Read `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root, in full, before writing or editing anything. It's the entry
   point for every session in this repo — scope, the required reading order before touching code,
   GitHub workflow, dos/don'ts, and a strict pre-commit checklist.
3. First time in this repo, or a machine that hasn't been set up before? Read `docs/ONBOARDING.md`
   next — prerequisites, git/GitHub CLI authentication (Windows/macOS/Linux), cloning, local dev,
   and opening a first pull request.
4. From there, follow `CLAUDE.md`'s own "Before writing any code" section — it names the rest of
   the documentation for whatever the actual task is, in the order to read it.

## Ground rules, in short

- This file only exists to get an agent to `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/ONBOARDING.md` — it is not a
  substitute for either.
- Always check the documentation before assuming how something works. If the docs don't answer
  the question, ask a human collaborator rather than guess.
- `main` is a protected branch that deploys straight to production on merge. Every change,
  without exception, goes through a pull request.

## For humans

This is a machine-readable entry point for coding agents, not a page meant to be browsed. The
game is at https://supremacy.live/; the codebase is at https://github.com/Synxpsis/supremacylive.
